title: The Priests and Levites Move to Jerusalem
description: Because Jeroboam and his sons rejected the Levites as priests for the Lord and instead appointed their own priests for the high places, the goat demons, and the calves, the priests and Levites from all Israel left their pasture lands and property and moved to Judah and Jerusalem. People from all the tribes of Israel who sought the Lord with all their heart followed them, strengthening the kingdom of Judah and supporting Rehoboam for three years as they walked in the ways of David and Solomon.
